description: Bible version allowlist (#139): the single source of truth for which Bible versions J-Life offers, where their text comes from, and whether J-Life may show it on the page. Only an enabled version with display "native" and recorded license_evidence may render text; everything else is a Bible Gateway link. Each language's default is the version whose default_for lists it; its fallback is the link used when the default cannot render. Switching a default (e.g. to ERV/BPT once Bible League licenses them) is an edit here, not a code change. bin/validate-scripture.js checks the rules; the reading-plan builder takes links_config from the languages block.
